findings.current: One person or another, once revered as a great warrior, died. Then died again. And again.
findings.defect: “Then died again” makes it sound as though the same person dies repeatedly.
findings.rationale: The repeated deaths are of successive people once revered as powerful martial artists.
findings.replacement: One revered master died, then another, and another.
findings.source: 강자로 추앙받던 어디의 누군가가 죽고, 죽고, 또 죽고.

findings.current:
“What is that…?”

I couldn’t bring myself to say the rest aloud.
findings.defect: The draft voices the question that Taekyung cannot bring himself to say, removing the distinction between his speech and thought.
findings.rationale: He begins aloud, asks what it is internally, then explains why he cannot speak the rest.
findings.replacement:
“That’s…”

*What the hell is that?*

I couldn’t bring myself to say the rest aloud.
findings.source:
“저건…….”

도대체 뭐지?

그 뒷말은 차마 소리 내어 내뱉지도 못했다.

findings.defect: Mujin mishears “undead” as “Eom Dae-du”; the draft removes the misunderstanding and adds profanity to his polite question.
findings.rationale: The phonetic mishearing and deferential question are both present in the Korean.

findings.current: Even in a situation like this, they showed no fear or agitation—not even the pain they should’ve been feeling.
findings.defect: The draft replaces the absence of screams with an absence of fear.
findings.rationale: 비명 means screams; the unnerving observation is that the burned figures make no cry of pain.
findings.replacement: Even in a situation like this, they neither screamed nor showed any agitation—not even a sign of the pain they should’ve been feeling.
findings.source: 이런 상황에서도 그 어떤 비명이나 동요도, 심지어 당연히 느껴야 할 고통조차 보이지 않은 채.

findings.current: There are plenty of strong people among the demonic, heterodox arts, too.
findings.defect: “People among … arts” is an unnatural English construction.
findings.rationale: The speaker is pointing out powerful martial artists outside the orthodox faction.
findings.replacement: Plenty of powerful fighters practice demonic and heterodox arts, too.
findings.source: 사마외도 중에도 강한 놈들이 얼마나 많은데.

summary: The draft preserves the scene overall, but changes a sequence of deaths into repeated deaths of one person and misses several character and dialogue cues.
